I wanted to help those who would like to start homeschooling but may feel overwhelm or think it is too expensive.

Why Should You Homeschool

  • Transportation’s time. Parents like to value this as “quality time” but it isn’t truly quality time since the parents attention is on the road.
  • Expect to pay $637 in supplies, fees, uniforms or “school” clothing, fundraisers, gifts, and donations per child each year.
  • If you work or have other children, you may have to take time off or hire babysitters for conferences, concerts, parents nights, and meetings
  • You are an after thought for curriculum choices.
  • You are expected to be involved in your child’s education with school volunteering and involvement but are to keep the teachers and staff decisions above your own “in your child’s best interest”
  • You get more time with your children in their formative years where you become a primary impact, not their friends or the state

How to get started homeschooling

  • Go to your school district’s website and search homeschool. It should have information on required notification and minimum covered subjects. Make sure you note any records you may have to keep like attendance, books used, etc.
  • Join a local homeschool group or reach out to a groups online. I say groups because each has their own center from core focused, to unschooling, to classical based to common knowledge and more. A good place to start is your local library but if you are a bit ore remote, Facebook (I gagged a little. Have a throwaway and thick skin).
  • Most curriculum does not change yearly or even every decade. EBay and Amazon has good deal on used books. If you are loss on what to teach every year, the What Your Grader Needs to Know books give some good direction and are at most libraries.
  • Remember that your homeschool day doesn’t not have to look like a public school day. You can cover some areas and take a long lunch break, run errands and cover a couple more later. You may not get to history because science turned into a 2 hour investigation or you didn’t get to literature because the dryer broke and you are showing your kids how to search YouTube how to repair it.
